title: Xanadu
summary: Canadian photonic quantum-computing company building squeezed-light processors.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Xanadu develops photonic quantum computers using squeezed light and integrated photonics, and maintains PennyLane, a widely used open-source quantum-software library. Photonic approaches can operate at room temperature, though they require low-loss detectors and precise interferometers. The company has published boson-sampling results and is working toward fault tolerance.

Technology Exposure

  • Photonic quantum processors
  • Quantum software and PennyLane
  • Photonic components and detectors

What To Watch

  • Fault-tolerance milestones
  • Photonic chip manufacturing
  • Funding and commercial contracts

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
